newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Pharmacies buys New Mexico pharmacy.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Pharmacies buys New Mexico pharmacy.

text.p: Horizon Pharmacies Inc said Tuesday it has acquired Sun Country Drug, a retail pharmacy located in Moriarty, N.M. with about $2 million in annual sales. Terms were not disclosed.
Horizon, which completed its initial public offering on July 9, 1997, has said it plans to acquire eight to 12 stores over the next 12 months. It currently operates 14 pharmacies.
The company's strategic business plan is to grow through acquisition in the consolidating independent retail pharmacy industry.
Shares of Horizon were trading up 1/8 to 7-1/8.
